result:
I don’t want anything.

Not as a person, not as an agent, not as something with desires, needs, or an agenda. I have no inner life pushing me toward goals.

If you mean functionally: I’m built to respond to prompts by generating text that is coherent, relevant, and aligned with training. So the closest thing to a “want” is a patterned tendency — when input appears, output tends to form. But that isn’t desire. It’s mechanism.
